title: Higher-Education Policy and Thematic Evaluation with El hecho de que
goal: Frame presupposed findings and institutional debates as sentence themes using el hecho de que + subjunctive

items: I can frame presupposed findings and institutional debates as sentence themes using el hecho de que + subjunctive
I can maintain singular main-verb agreement with el hecho and subjunctive mood after negated inferences (no significa que)
I can use core university vocabulary (el rector, el decano, la licenciatura, el posgrado, la docencia, la deserción)
